description: spec 06 section 4.4 rule 9 and spec 09 section 7 — the order in which a gate submission is refused, and which refusal earns a durable record. Run the admission predicate over `input`; `expected.outcome` is `queued`, `already-queued`, or the reason code the refusal carries, `expected.status` is the HTTP status, and `expected.record` is whether the kernel MUST write a section 04 rule 7.1 rejection-stream record for it. `arguments-check` is the section 4.4 rule 3/4 result over the submitted values (`null` when the member was omitted); `mismatches-in-window` counts the subject's OWN recorded argument mismatches in the window, which is not `parked-in-window` and is zero for a component that only ever lies.
role-note: the admission order is the kernel's part; an emitter never runs it

vectors.name: no-arguments-queues
vectors.description: a component that never held the preimage omits the member and parks normally

vectors.name: matching-arguments-queue
vectors.description: the ordinary path: the values are what the request commits to

vectors.name: a-retry-of-a-queued-request-is-idempotent
vectors.description: a component retrying after a lost response is behaving correctly and is not counted twice for it, even with the queue at its cap

vectors.name: a-mismatch-is-recorded
vectors.description: the finding ADR-0011 section 2 asked for: a component submitted values its own args-hash does not cover, and the organization gets to see it

vectors.name: a-mismatch-on-an-already-queued-request-is-still-recorded
vectors.description: idempotency is about the request, never about the lie: the retry skip must not launder a mismatch into silence

vectors.name: a-mismatch-one-below-the-cap-is-recorded
vectors.description: the paired positive for the case below: one short of the cap still records

vectors.name: a-mismatch-at-the-cap-is-rate-limited-and-not-recorded
vectors.description: the bound: a component cannot write to the audit chain faster than section 09 rule 7 lets it park, and the refusal it receives says which limit it met

vectors.name: parked-rows-at-the-cap-do-not-suppress-the-record
vectors.description: which counter bounds the record: a subject at the queue cap that has recorded no mismatch still earns one, so an implementation counting parked rows fails here

vectors.name: too-large-is-refused-and-not-recorded
vectors.description: a size refusal is a bound, not a finding: the component was honest and verbose, and rule 3 already tells it to park without the values

vectors.name: too-large-is-not-bounded-by-the-mismatch-count
vectors.description: the bound applies to the recorded condition only: an over-sized submission is refused on its own terms even from a subject at the mismatch cap

vectors.name: the-queue-cap-still-refuses-a-fresh-honest-request
vectors.description: unchanged by any of the above, and asserted so a change to the record path cannot move it unnoticed
